regions.full_page: All Souls Day. Remarkable - Sept. 21st. p.m. John Coneff phoned "Enroll W. C. Hickey ... very low, in Ser. Mass As'n." Same W.C.H. died at 6:30 p.m. same day ..... Hickey had been very generous in helpin poor failing to pay his insurance .... wife had thrown policy away ..... no hope of recovering anything .... .. Sept. 22 Coneff enrolls new organization .... CATHOLIC Beneficial Society ....... Be- yond all hopes Mrs. hickey % this said society recovered and re- ceived what was coming to her ..... $752.59 - insisting on remuner- ating Coneff 10%. She proposed giving 50% which was positively refused. Mrs. Hickey becomes first charter member. Said J. Con- eff opened Office yesterday All Saints Day at 1006 Lafayette Bldg. P.S. Funeral expenses paid by (said) Insurance Co. - % said So- ciety J.C.L. Nov. 4 "Ad" Nov. 2nd brings 500 letters - Nov. 3rd! !!
